description: This file implements the DobbyInterface class, which manages container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, pause, resume, and state change notifications for containers managed via Dobby. It interacts with external components like DobbyProxy and OmiProxy, handles container events, and provides container information.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class that manages container lifecycle operations and event notifications using DobbyProxy and OmiProxy.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DobbyInterface with an event handler, sets up IPC, and registers listeners.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters listeners, and resets the event handler.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of running containers managed by Dobby.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle, handling encrypted bundles if necessary.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby-specific specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container, with optional force.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation key from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source into a container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem target from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event handler for container start events.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event handler for container stop events.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for container state change events.

methods.name: GetContainerDescriptorFromId
methods.description: Converts a container ID to an internal descriptor.

methods.name: GetContainerIdFromDescriptor
methods.description: Converts a descriptor back to a container ID.

methods.name: stateListener
methods.description: Callback for container state change events.

methods.name: omiErrorListener
methods.description: Callback for OMI error events.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Handles verity check failures for containers.
